description: Horaires théoriques et temps réels du réseau de transports L'Agglo en Bus - Communauté d'Agglomération Gap-Tallard-Durance is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Gap-Tallard-Durance. The Community of Aglomeration manages the competence “Transport” in the 17 municipalities of the territory “Gap-Tallard-Durance”, through the completely free network “L’Agglo by bus”. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Gap-Tallard-Durance. The portal shows the English title as "Theoretical timetables and real time of the transport network L’Agglo en Bus – Community of Agglomeration Gap-Tallard-Du" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Gap-Tallard-Durance. Its keywords include gtfs-rt, gtfs. The listing shows 2 download or service links in GTFS, GTFS-RT. The listing shows 2026-04-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
